title: Laptop Battery replacement
description:
Computer Battery Replacement

At E-Tech, we provide professional laptop and computer battery replacement services, following standard diagnostic and safety procedures to ensure stable power performance and battery reliability.

All batteries are replaced using OEM or OEM-equivalent battery units, tested for compatibility, capacity, and charging stability.


Service Includes

• Battery not charging or charging intermittently

• Rapid battery drain

• Swollen or overheating battery

• Unexpected shutdowns or power instability


Why E-Tech

• Experienced technicians in power and battery systems

• OEM-quality replacement batteries

• ESD-safe, model-specific replacement process

• Typical repair time: 1-2 working days

• 3-month warranty

• No Fix, No Fee

• Free diagnostics


Professional Battery Replacement You Can Trust

Bring your laptop or computer to E-Tech for a safe, precise, and reliable battery replacement.
